basics.name: Shahab Sherafat
basics.label: Computer Engineering Student & AI Researcher
basics.summary: Computer engineering undergraduate at the University of Tehran, with a minor in psychology. Research interests span robust and explainable AI, generative modeling, cognitive science, computational neuroscience, and AI for medicine.

work.name: Helmholtz Munich
work.summary: Developing uncertainty quantification frameworks for Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) in biomedical image segmentation. Evaluating model reliability and predictive confidence on benchmark cytological datasets.
highlights: Supervisors: Prof. Carsten Marr and Dr. Ario Sadafi.

work.name: Sharif University of Technology
work.summary: Developing and evaluating methods to improve adversarial robustness in speech foundation models and transfer robustness to specialized downstream models.
highlights: Robustness after Specialization: Installing Adversarial Robustness in Speech Foundation Model Descendants — submitted to ICLR.
Transferable Adversarial Robustness for Speech Foundation Models via Hierarchical Stabilization — submitted to ICASSP.

work.name: University of Tehran
work.summary: Evaluated generative deep learning models (Diffusion, VAE, LDM) for MRI-based disease classification, using self-supervised representations to mitigate clinical data scarcity.
highlights: Supervisors: Prof. Ahmad Kalhor and Dr. Saeed Masoudnia.

work.name: TEIAS
work.summary: Designed an LLM-based chatbot and agent for a study investigating undergraduate mathematics learning. Evaluated learning retention and automated feedback.
highlights: Co-authored a paper accepted at ICCE 2026.

courses: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. Expected graduation: 2028.
